messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this project matters beyond the immediate order. We value that relationship and will ensure reliable, on-time payment rather than leave you carrying uncertainty over our payments. How could that payment certainty translate into a more competitive price for the new series?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.70 per unit, 45 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

You have highlighted available capacity and Hollerau’s value as a reference; it sounds like dependable new business matters to you. We recognise that our late payments have strained the relationship and will ensure reliable, on-time payment. How much sharper could you make your unit price for the new series in exchange for faster payment?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. We have an offer at EUR 36.00 per unit (offer:70210-0). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.25 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Hallo, thanks for the straight talk on the payments, getting cash in 14 days really helps us out. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. With the 14 days payment and the volume you promised, I can drop the price a lot. Let's do €31.00 per piece and we have a deal. So our offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
